steps.note: Open a single-stage create screen for the RFQ used by the vendor test.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available RFQ template so the bid sheet can be created.
Add one line item for the vendor's bid sheet.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to the event.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Verify the event is available on its project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal.
Open the event's vendor pricing sheet without submitting a bid.
Enter a partial bid value and leave the bid unsubmitted.

args.goal: reload the vendor portal and reopen this event's pricing sheet; verify that the partially entered Price value 100 is restored, or that Procol shows a warning before leaving, and stop on the screen proving one of those outcomes

steps.note: Perform and verify the reload-and-reopen behavior, including either draft restoration or a leave warning.
